description: Public arena state. WHEN: public snapshot of live arena state (same JSON as /arena/state.json, schema_version 2: active_games with scores[], ticks_remaining, powerups_active, plus per-game telemetry block). Differs from arena_get_state (owner/full single match) and arena_spectate (one match by id). Read-only, no key required. Credit: Dead Brands. Pass match_id for one match's public board (same as arena_spectate) or omit it for the whole-city snapshot. Example: {}

match_id.description: Optional. Pass a match id to get that one match's public board (same as arena_spectate). Omit for the whole-city snapshot.

name: arena_state
title: Public arena state
